name: Orbit AI - Phase 4 - Tier upgrade signal (W4.2)

nodes.name: Every day at 6:30am
nodes.notes: Runs 30 minutes after health-scoring.workflow.json (W4.1, 6am) so engagementScore/currentTier are fresh for today before this reads them. 05 Section 9's table: 'Tier upgrade/upsell signal - off W4.1's output - Auto to flag/draft; human closes the upsell.'

nodes.name: Fetch LiveClient Companies
nodes.notes: Fetches the whole LiveClient set and filters client-side (next node) rather than a numeric >= filter query - Twenty CRM's REST filter support for numeric comparisons isn't confirmed, same discipline as missed-follow-up-check.workflow.json's own client-side filter.

nodes.name: Alert: tier-upgrade signal

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'tier-upgrade-signal', message: $json.name + ' is upgrade-eligible - engagement score ' + $json.engagementScore + ', current tier ' + $json.currentTier + '. Flag for a rep to pursue the upsell.', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/company/' + $json.id }) }}

nodes.notes: Auto-flags only - per the automation risk boundary and the table's own Gate column ('Auto to flag/draft; human closes the upsell'), this never contacts the client itself, it alerts a rep to go pursue it. Routes to #cx-retention (alertRouting.ts matches sources containing 'tier-upgrade').
